sn22.58:1.2: tathāgato bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto sammāsambuddho’ti vuccati.
sn22.58:1.3: bhikkhupi bhikkhave, paññāvimutto rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto ‘paññāvimutto’ti vuccati.
sn22.58:3.3: viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto ‘sammāsambuddho’ti vuccati.
sn22.58:3.4: bhikkhupi bhikkhave, paññāvimutto viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto ‘paññāvimutto’ti vuccati.
sn22.58:4.1: tatra bhikkhave, ko viseso ko adhippāyo kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ, tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunāti?
sn22.58:4.2: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn22.58:4.3: tena hi bhikkhave, suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
sn22.58:4.4: evaṃ bhante’ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn22.58:5.1: tathāgato bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā. asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā. anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā. maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido,
sn22.58:5.2: maggānugā ca bhikkhave, etarahi sāvakā viharanti, pacchā samannāgatā.
sn22.58:5.3: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, viseso ayaṃ adhippāyo, idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunāti.
